sharpe_recipe: Always use the *_pnl files. sr = pnl[market].dropna().mean() / pnl[market].dropna().std() * sqrt(252). carry_ois_par_pnl: §6.2 income+roll-down, DV01-neutral 5Y+10Y cross-section, daily rebalance. mean_reversion_pnl: per-tenor z-score × (−Δresid), summed. momentum_a_daily_pnl: per-tenor vol-scaled positions × daily CM returns, summed.
